sources.title: Models.dev undated Ministral 14B record
sources.evidence: The upstream undated entry explicitly links the Ministral-3-14B-Instruct-2512 checkpoint and the December 2025 Mistral 3 launch. This establishes the catalog record’s intended identity; its capability assertions are verified separately with developer sources.

sources.title: Introducing Mistral 3
sources.evidence: December 2, 2025 launch introduces the dense 3B, 8B and 14B Ministral 3 sizes, each with base, instruct and reasoning variants, and releases them under Apache 2.0. It describes local and edge deployment.

sources.title: Ministral 3 14B v25.12 — model reference and Weights table
sources.evidence: Exact official page identifies the December 2 release and links Instruct, Reasoning and Base checkpoints separately. The Instruct Weights row in the delivered React payload explicitly reports Parameters (B)=14 and Active (B)=14, Apache 2.0 and 256k context.

sources.title: Ministral 3 14B — official Markdown model reference
sources.evidence: Explicitly names API identifiers ministral-14b-2512 and ministral-14b-latest, text/image input, text output, function calling, December 2 release and 256k context. The bare ministral-14b catalog key is not itself established as an API endpoint identifier.

sources.title: Ministral 3 14B Instruct 2512 — pinned official checkpoint card
sources.evidence: Identifies the FP8 instruction variant separately from Base and Reasoning. States a nominal 13.5B language model and 0.4B vision encoder, Apache 2.0, native function calling, text/image understanding and 256k context. The serving notes explicitly give default max-model-len 262144.

sources.title: Ministral 3 14B Instruct — pinned Transformers configuration
sources.evidence: Mistral3ForConditionalGeneration with a dense ministral3 language decoder: 40 layers, hidden size 5120, FFN size 16384, 32 query and 8 KV heads, 131072 vocabulary, untied embeddings and max_position_embeddings 262144. Includes a 24-layer Pixtral vision encoder and projector; FP8 quantization excludes these vision modules and the output head.

sources.title: Ministral 3 technical report
sources.evidence: January 2026 report explicitly describes dense decoder-only Transformers, GQA, SwiGLU, RMSNorm and YaRN. Table 1 provides the exact 14B configuration. Section 2 separately describes a 410M-parameter ViT plus a newly trained projector. It distinguishes Instruct from Reasoning post-training and their context limits.

sources.title: Mistral maintainer correction of unused reasoning tokens
sources.evidence: Mistral organization maintainer juliendenize explicitly identifies this exact Instruct repository as non-reasoning and explains that unused THINK tokens were renamed to prevent tooling from falsely treating it as reasoning-capable. The change was merged June 30, 2026; only tokenizer files changed.

sources.title: Official checkpoint repository metadata
sources.evidence: Public, ungated repository at revision 29439f81c2be264d8d393273f99e7db9c0961120, containing native and Transformers weights. Pinned card/configuration/index were retrieved; the index has 1145 entries including FP8 scales, which are not treated as learned parameters.

sources.title: Public pinned weight shard availability probe
sources.evidence: An unauthenticated Range request for bytes 0–7 succeeded with HTTP 206 and Content-Range bytes 0-7/4980912374. Exactly eight bytes were read; safetensors header length is 22560. This verifies downloadable weights without downloading a full shard.

name.note: Expand the undated catalog shorthand using the exact linked checkpoint; distinguish the Instruct variant from Base and Reasoning.

developer.note: Official Mistral AI announcement and checkpoint; retain the normalized developer label.

family.note: Developer explicitly places this checkpoint in the Ministral 3 family.

release_date.note: Dated public launch and model reference agree. January 2026 technical-report publication is not the release date.

open_weights.note: Exact official checkpoint is public, ungated and downloadable; verified with a bounded eight-byte weight request.

license.note: Explicit model license in the launch, exact checkpoint metadata/body and Instruct Weights table. No separate LICENSE file appears in the repository listing.

parameters_b.note: Developer’s nominal whole-model size in billions. The card separately gives rounded 13.5B language and 0.4B vision figures; do not replace nominal 14B with an exact-looking sum or the FP8 storage aggregate.

active_parameters_b.note: Official exact Instruct Weights row directly labels Active (B)=14. This is nominal disclosure, not an inference from dense architecture or an asserted per-modality FLOP count.

architecture.note: Explicit dense architecture is corroborated by the 40-layer GQA language decoder and vision encoder/projector. No MoE routing is inferred from another Mistral release.

context_window.note: Checkpoint config and serving notes explicitly specify 262144. The separate Reasoning variant’s shorter context and third-party hosting limits do not apply to this Instruct checkpoint.

modalities.note: Native vision encoder/projector accepts images alongside text; the model generates text. No native audio or image generation is claimed.

reasoning.note: Explicit exact-checkpoint maintainer statement settles dedicated native reasoning; ordinary reasoning benchmarks in the family card do not make this the Reasoning variant.

tool_call.note: Official model reference lists Function Calling; the exact checkpoint card provides native Mistral tool parsing and function schemas.

description.value: Multimodal instruction model for local assistants and edge agents, with native function calling.
description.note: Restrict description to documented instruction, local deployment, vision and native tools; remove subjective efficiency claim.

patch.name: Ministral 3 14B Instruct
patch.description: Multimodal instruction model for local assistants and edge agents, with native function calling.
patch.notes: This undated catalog entry explicitly links Ministral-3-14B-Instruct-2512; official API names are ministral-14b-2512 and ministral-14b-latest. Specifications here describe that Instruct checkpoint, not Base or Reasoning. Mistral reports nominal 14B total and 14B active parameters; rounded component figures and FP8 storage totals are not exact whole-model counts. The checkpoint context is 262,144 tokens. A Mistral maintainer explicitly confirms it is non-reasoning.

summary: Audited all 14 fields for the undated catalog alias, tracing its own weight link to Ministral 3 14B Instruct 2512. Add directly disclosed nominal 14B active parameters, dense architecture and primary parameter provenance; clarify the official variant name and description. Verify December 2 release, public Apache-2.0 weights, 262144 context, native text/image input and tools, and explicitly non-reasoning status. Bare catalog ID is not asserted to be a live API endpoint; Base and Reasoning specifications are kept separate.
